Practice Questions - 2
Government Schemes

[Type here]


     Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs


I.101-102) Read the following passage and answer the questions that follow –

Scheme X was launched in 2013 to reduce poverty by enabling the poor households to access
gainful self-employment and skilled wage employment opportunities. The scheme is being
implemented with its various components viz; Social mobilisation and institutional development,
capacity building and training, Employment through skill training and placements, self-
employment program etc. Mukesh is a jobless resident of Delhi. While eating Pakoras at a road
side stall, he gave ears to the conversation going on among three RBI aspirants who were also
having Pakoras at the same stall. They were discussing about the scheme X. While discussing the
scheme X, the three friends talked about a component (Employment through skill training and
placements) of the scheme under which assistance is provided for development / upgrading of the
skills of the urban poor to enhance their capacity for self-employment and salaried employment.
After hearing all this conversation, Mukesh went to a nearby common service centre where he
enrolled himself as a beneficiary of the scheme X.

Q.101) How much cost the government will bear to provide training to Mukesh for gaining self-
employment under the component - Employment through skill training and placements of the
scheme X?

[a] Rs.12000
[b] Rs.15000
[c] Rs.18000
[d] Rs.10000
[e] Rs.7500

Solution – [b]

Explanation – The scheme X is DAY-NULM. The cost of training per beneficiary shall not exceed
Rs.15,000 (Rs.18,000 for North-Eastern and Special Category States)

Q.102) Under the scheme X, how much percent reservation is provided to women, minorities and
PwDs respectively?

[a] 30%, 10% and 3%
[b] 25%, 15% and 3%
[c] 15%, 15% and 2%
[d] 30%, 20% and 1%
[e] 30%, 15% and 3%

Solution – [e]



                                                                                                                         pg. 2

[Type here]



Explanation – Reservations - Women – 30%, Minorities – 15% and PWDs – 3%

Q.103) Which of the following statements is incorrect with respect to the financial assistance
provided under a scheme launched in 2015 for ensuring pucca houses to all the eligible households
in urban areas by 2022?

[a] Under In-situ slum redevelopment component, Central Assistance of Rs.1 lakh per house is
admissible for all houses built for eligible slum
[b] All LIG households can avail Rs.6 Lakhs as loan for buying house under credit linked subsidy
component
[c] Central Assistance of Rs. 1.5 Lakh per EWS house is provided by the Government of India under
affordable housing in partnership component
[d] Under Beneficiary led construction component, Central Assistance up to Rs. 1.5 lakh per EWS
house is provided to eligible families belonging to EWS categories for individual house
construction/ enhancement
[e] For middle income group – I category of beneficiaries, an interest subsidy of 4% is applicable on
the loan amount up to Rs.12 Lakhs

Solution – [e]

Explanation – The Scheme asked in the question is PM Awas Yojana – Urban.
   •  For middle income group – I category of beneficiaries, an interest subsidy of 4% is
       applicable on the loan amount up to Rs.9 Lakhs

Q.104) HRIDAY scheme was launched in 2015 by ministry of housing and urban affairs for holistic
development of the heritage cities of the country thereby preserving rich heritage of India. The
total outlay of the scheme is Rs.500 Crore. What does A stand for in HRIDAY?

[a] Application
[b] Administration
[c] Augmentation
[d] Aspiration
[e] Addition

Solution – [c]

Explanation – HRIDAY Stands for Heritage City Development and Augmentation Yojana

Q.105) To transform 500 cities and towns, scheme Y was launched in 2015 by ministry of housing
and urban affairs with a total outlay of Rs.50,000 Crores. In 2021, the second edition of scheme Y
has been launched for a duration of 5 years. Which of the following statements is incorrect with
respect to the second edition of scheme Y?





                                                                                                                         pg. 3

[Type here]



[a] The second edition aims to provide reliable 2.68 crore new water tap connections to all in
about 4,800 statutory towns
[b] Projects amounting to at least 10% of total project allocation for all cities with population
above 10 lakhs in a State will be mandatorily taken up in PPP mode
[c] To assess compliance of service level benchmarks with respect to quality, quantity, and
coverage of water supply, Pey Jal Survekshan shall be conducted
[d] It is a central sector scheme, with a total outlay of Rs.2,77,000 Crores
[e] The scheme targets a universal household coverage of sewerage/septage services in 500
AMRUT cities through 2.64 crore new sewer connections

Solution – [d]

Explanation – It is a centrally sponsored scheme.
   •  Central share – Rs.76,760 Crores
   •  The funds for the projects will be shared by Centre, State and ULBs.
   •  Central funds will be released to the States in three tranches of 20:40:40, based on
       allocation to the State as per State Water Action Plan

Q.106) Scheme X was launched in …………… to provide working capital loans to the street vendors.
The Scheme is available to all street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas as on or
before ………………… Under the scheme, …………….. is provided as a working capital loan for a period
of 1 year. The scheme X provides interest subsidy of 7%. Recently, the lending period under the
scheme has been extended till ………………… to give benefits to 42 Lakh Street vendors. Fill the gaps.

[a] 2021, 24th March 2020, Rs.10,000, December 2023
[b] 2020, 23rd March 2020, Rs.10,000, December 2025
[c] 2020, 24th March 2020, Rs.10,000, December 2024
[d] 2020, 24th March 2020, Rs.20,000, December 2024
[e] 2020, 31st March 2020, Rs.10,000, December 2025

Solution – [c]

Explanation – The Scheme X mentioned in the passage is PM SVANidhi

Q.107) On successful completion of Swacch Bharat Mission – Urban, SBM-U 2.0 was launched in
2021 with enhanced objectives. Which of the following is not one of the focus areas of the 2nd
edition of the scheme?

[a] Access to sanitation facilities to serve additional population migrating from rural to urban areas
[b] Complete liquid waste management in cities in less than 50,000 population
[c] Solid waste management with emphasis on source segregation
[d] Setting up of Material recovery facilities and waste processing facilities
[e] Remediation of all legacy dumpsites to clear up the 15 crore tonnes legacy waste



                                                                                                                         pg. 4

[Type here]



Solution – [b]

Explanation – The focus areas are –

   •  Access to sanitation facilities to serve additional population migrating from rural to urban
       areas. This will be done through construction of over 3.5 lakhs individual, community and
       public toilets.
   •  Complete liquid waste management in cities in less than 1 lakh population.
   •  Solid waste management with emphasis on source segregation. Material recovery facilities
     and waste processing facilities will be set up.
   •  Remediation of all legacy dumpsites.

Q.108) Scheme M was launched in 2015 to promote sustainable and inclusive cities that provides
core infrastructure, a decent quality of life to its citizens and a clean and sustainable environment.
The target number of cities under the scheme is 100 and initially its duration was 5 years, which
has been recently extended till –

[a] December 2023
[b] June 2024
[c] December 2024
[d] June 2024
[e] December 2025

Solution – [d]

Explanation – The scheme M, mentioned in the passage is Smart Cities Mission. It has been
extended till June 2024.

Q.109) For documentation of landmark projects undertaken by the Smart Cities Mission, ministry
of housing and urban affairs has launched Smart cities and Academia Towards Action & Research
(SAAR) program in January 2022. Under the program, 15 premier architecture & planning institutes
of the country will be working with Smart Cities to document landmark projects. How many
landmark projects are being documented under the program?

[a] 100
[b] 125
[c] 75
[d] 150
[e] 225

Solution – [c]





                                                                                                                         pg. 5

[Type here]



Q.110) Consider the following statements with respect to NAMASTE project of the ministry of
housing and urban affairs and identify the correct statement/s

(1) NAMASTE, which stands for National Action Plan for Manual Sanitation Ecosystem is a joint
initiative of ministry of social justice and empowerment and ministry of housing and urban affairs
(2) The project shall be implemented in 500 cities with total outlay of Rs.360 Crores
(3) The nodal implementing agencies for the project is National Safai Karamchari Financial
Development Corporation and National Institute of Urban Affairs
(4) Under the scheme, Septic/Sewer Tank Workers and their families will be provided with health
insurance coverage under Ayushman Bharat
(5) Under the scheme, loans will be provided for sanitation equipment for which rate of interest
shall be 5%

[a] Only 1, 4 and 5
[b] Only 1, 3 and 5
[c] Only 1, 2, 3 and 4
[d] Only 2, 4 and 5
[e] All 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5

Solution – [d]

Explanation –
   •  NAMASTE stands for National Action Plan for Mechanized Sanitation Ecosystem, is a joint
        initiative of ministry of social justice and empowerment and ministry of housing and urban
        affairs
   •  The nodal implementing agency is National Safai Karamchari Financial Development
      Corporation
         Ministry of Electronics & IT


Q.111) For making one person in every rural family digitally literate to make them able to use
digital services like banking services, railway reservation, electricity bill payment, UIDAI services
etc, ministry of electronics and IT launched a scheme in 2017. The nodal implementing agency for
the scheme is CSC e – governance services India limited. Identify the correct statements with
respect to the scheme.

(1) Under the scheme, one person per household is eligible for training and total 6 Crore rural
households will be covered
(2) The beneficiary should be in the age group of 15-35 years
(3) UNDP is the international partner in the scheme
(4) Under the scheme, preference is being given to SC, ST, Women, Differently abled persons and
minorities



                                                                                                                         pg. 6

[Type here]



[a] Only 1, 2 and 3
[b] Only 1 and 4
[c] Only 2 and 3
[d] Only 2, 3 and 4
[e] Only 3

Solution – [b]

Explanation –
   •  The beneficiary should be in the age group of 15-35 years
   •  UNESCO is the international partner in the scheme

Q.112) To connect national academic and R&D institutions with a grid of high performing
supercomputing facilities, National Supercomputing Mission was launched in 2015. The mission is
based on 4 broad pillars. Which of the following is not one of the 4 pillars of the mission?

[a] Infrastructure
[b] Applications
[c] Technology upgradation
[d] Research & Development
[e] Human Resource Development

Solution – [c]

Explanation –

Pillars of the mission
   •  Infrastructure
   •  Applications
   •  Research & development
   •  Human Resource Development

Q.113) Union cabinet has approved an Incentive Scheme to Promote Rupay Debit Cards and low
value BHIM UPI transactions in the country. It will help in in making accessible digital modes of
payments to unbanked and marginalized populations. The scheme has been approved for FY 2022-
23 with an outlay of –

[a] Rs.1200 Crores
[b] Rs.2300 Crores
[c] Rs.3000 Crores
[d] Rs.2600 Crores
[e] Rs.5100 Crores

Solution – [d]

                                                                                                                         pg. 7

[Type here]



Q.114) Name the initiative launched by the ministry of electronics and IT in 2021 to support
existing and upcoming Accelerators to further select and accelerate potential software product-
based start-ups to scale and accelerate the start-ups by providing customer connect, investor
connect and internationalization connect services.

[a] SAKSHAM
[b] SAMRIDH
[c] SAMARTH
[d] SAMRAT
[e] SHAKTI

Solution – [b]

Explanation - SAMRIDH stands for ‘Start-up Accelerator Programme of MeitY for Product
Innovation, Development and Growth’.
          Ministry of Minority Affairs


Q.115) Shubham belongs to a minority group. He is a B. Com (Hons) graduate from Delhi
University. He aspires to be a civil servant but does not have enough sources to avail coaching for
the same. While reading a newspaper, he came across a scheme which is meant only for minority
students. Under the scheme, ministry of minority affairs provides assistance by way of special
coaching for qualifying examinations for admissions in technical and professional courses such as
engineering, medical, law, management etc. and competitive examinations for recruitment in
group A, B and C services and other equivalent posts under the central and state governments. To
get the benefits of the scheme, total income of Shubham from all sources should not
exceed ………… per annum. After enrolling as a beneficiary under the scheme, Shubham will
get …………. as stipend.

[a] Rs.5 Lakhs, Rs.2500
[b] Rs.6 Lakhs, Rs.2500
[c] Rs.6 Lakhs, Rs.3000
[d] Rs.5 Lakhs, Rs.7500
[e] Rs.6 Lakhs, Rs.7500

Solution – [b]

Explanation – The scheme mentioned in the passage is NAYA SAVERA. Shubham’s Total income
from all sources should be less than or equal to 6 lakh per annum. Shubham will get Rs.2500/- as
stipend.





                                                                                                                         pg. 8

[Type here]



I.116-118) Read the information given below about three schemes and answer the questions that
follow –

  •  Scheme X was launched in 2012-13 by the ministry of minority affairs to empower and instil
     confidence among minority women by providing knowledge, tools and techniques for
     interacting with government systems, banks and other institutions etc.
  •  Scheme Y was launched in 2015 to benefit the minority youths who do not have a formal
     school leaving certificate
  •  Scheme Z was launched by ministry of minority to provide financial support to the minority
     candidates clearing prelims conducted by UPSC, SSC and State PCSs

Q.116) How much financial assistance, under scheme Z, will be provided to Sakshi who is a
minority candidate and has cleared the prelims examination of SSC CGL?

[a] Rs.1,00,000
[b] Rs.75000
[c] Rs.65000
[d] Rs.50000
[e] Rs.25000

Solution – [e]

Explanation – The scheme Z is NAI UDAAN. Rate of financial assistance under the scheme is –
   •  UPSC – Rs.1,00,000
   •  State PSC (Gazetted) – Rs.50,000
   •  SSC (CGL) & CAPF (Group – B) – Rs.25000
   •  State PSC (Non – Gazetted) – Rs.25000

Q.117) The scheme X empower and instil confidence among minority women in the age group
of ……………. by providing knowledge, tools and techniques for interacting with government
systems, banks and other institutions etc.

[a] 15 to 35 years
[b] 18 to 40 years
[c] 18 to 55 years
[d] 18 to 65 years
[e] 15 to 50 years

Solution – [d]

Explanation – The scheme X is NAI ROSHNI.





                                                                                                                         pg. 9

[Type here]



Q.118) Scheme Y is a …………….. scheme, partially supported by ……………….

[a] Centrally sponsored, World Bank
[b] Central Sector, IMF
[c] Central Sector, World Bank
[d] Centrally sponsored, Asian Development Bank
[e] Central sector, UNDP

Solution – [c]

Explanation – The scheme Y is NAI MANZIL. It is central sector scheme partially supported by
World Bank.

Q.119) Consider the following statements with respect to PM Jan Vikas Karyakram and identify the
correct statement/s

(1) The scheme has been approved for the 15th finance commission period; to be implemented in
308 minority concentration areas
(2) It is being implemented as a centrally sponsored scheme
(3) The scheme provides funds on sharing pattern for only infrastructure projects. Land is to be
provided free of cost by the State Government/ UT Administration / Central Government
Organization

[a] Only 1 and 3
[b] Only 2 and 3
[c] Only 1 and 2
[d] Only 1
[e] Only 3

Solution – [b]

Explanation – The revised scheme will be implemented in all Districts of the Country including all
the Aspirational Districts

Q.120) Seekho aur Kamao scheme is aimed at providing employment and employment
opportunities, improving the employability of existing workers, school dropouts to the minority
communities. It is a skill development scheme for youth of 14 - 35 years age group. How much
amount is provided as post placement support to placed trainees for two months?

[a] Rs.1500
[b] Rs.1000
[c] Rs.2000
[d] Rs.800
[e] Rs.1200


                                                                                                                        pg. 10

[Type here]



Solution – [c]

Q.121) Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship scheme is for meritorious Girls belonging to
Minorities, being implemented through Maulana Azad Education Foundation. To avail the
scholarship benefits of the scheme, annual parental income of the girl should not exceed –

[a] Rs.2.5 Lakhs per annum
[b] Rs.2.0 Lakhs per annum
[c] Rs.3.5 Lakhs per annum
[d] Rs.3.0 Lakhs per annum
[e] Rs.1.5 Lakhs per annum

Solution – [b]

Q.122) Padho Pardesh scheme was launched in ………………. to award interest subsidy to
meritorious students belonging to economically weaker sections of notified minority communities
for higher education abroad. To avail the subsidy, the student should have availed loan from a
scheduled bank under Education Loan Scheme of the Indian Banks Association and annual family
income of the candidate should not exceed ……………….. per annum. ………… seats are reserved for
girl students under the scheme. It is being implemented as a ………………..
Fill the gaps.

[a] 2013-14, Rs.8 Lakhs, 35%, Central sector scheme
[b] 2012-13, Rs.6 Lakhs, 35%, Centrally sponsored scheme
[c] 2013-14, Rs.6 Lakhs, 25%, Centrally sponsored scheme
[d] 2013-14, Rs.6 Lakhs, 35%, Central sector scheme
[e] 2013-14, Rs.8 Lakhs, 15%, Centrally sponsored scheme

Solution – [d]

I.123-124) Read the following passage and answer the questions that follow –

Scheme X was launched in 2021 by ministry of minority affairs by converging 5 existing schemes of
the ministry. The scheme X houses the objectives of all the 5 schemes. The scheme has 4
components viz; skilling and training, leadership and entrepreneurship, education and
infrastructure development.

Q.123) Which of the following is not one of the five schemes, converging which the scheme X was
launched?

[a] Seekho aur Kamao
[b] Nai Udaan
[c] Nai Roshni
[d] USTTAD


                                                                                                                        pg. 11

[Type here]



[e] Hamari Dharohar

Solution – [b]

Explanation – The scheme X mentioned in the passage is PM VIKAS (PM Virasat ka Samvardhan).
The scheme is a convergence of 5 existing schemes of ministry of minority affairs viz; Seekho aur
Kamao, USTTAD, Hamari Dharohar, Nai Roshni and Nai Manzil.

Q.124) Consider the following statements with respect to scheme X and identify the incorrect
statement/s

(1) Under leadership and entrepreneurship component of the scheme, 15% of the women trained
as entrepreneurs shall be selected Business Correspondents
(2) Vishwakarma Villages shall be developed under the infrastructure development component
(3) For Leadership and Entrepreneurship Component, the age group of beneficiaries should be 18-
25 years
(4) 100% funding is given by the ministry of minority affairs for the education component of the
scheme

[a] Only 1 and 2
[b] Only 2 and 3
[c] Only 1 and 3
[d] Only 2 and 4
[e] Only 3 and 4

Solution – [c]

Explanation –
   •  Under leadership and entrepreneurship component of the scheme, 15% of the women
       trained as entrepreneurs shall be selected Business Correspondents
   •  For Leadership and Entrepreneurship Component, the age group of beneficiaries should be
      18-45 years

Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship


Q.125) Consider the following statements with respect to National Apprenticeship Promotion
Scheme and identify the incorrect statement/s

(1) The scheme promotes apprenticeship in the country by providing financial incentives,
technology and advocacy support to the people who have at least 18 years of age
(2) The minimum educational qualification to get the benefits of the scheme is 5th Class pass
(3) Under the scheme, Reimbursement of 25% of stipend up to a maximum Rs.1500/- per month
per apprentice is provided by the Government of India to all employers who engage apprentices


                                                                                                                        pg. 12

[Type here]



[a] Only 1
[b] Only 2 and 3
[c] Only 1 and 2
[d] Only 2
[e] Only 3

Solution – [a]

Explanation – The scheme promotes apprenticeship in the country by providing financial
incentives, technology and advocacy support to the people who have at least 14 years of age

I.127) The scheme X was launched in 2015 by ministry of skill development with the following
mission statement – “To rapidly scale up skill development efforts in India, by creating an end to
end outcome focused implementation framework, which aligns demands of the employers for a
well - trained skill workforce with aspirations of Indian citizens for sustainable livelihoods”

Q.127) The scheme X is governed by a council headed by –

[a] Minister of skill development and entrepreneurship
[b] Prime Minister
[c] Union finance minister
[d] Secretary, Ministry of skill development and entrepreneurship
[e] Chairperson, National Skill Development Corporation

Solution – [b]

Explanation – The scheme X is National Skill Development Mission. The governing council is
headed by the Prime Minister

Q.128) The scheme Y was launched in 2015 to encourage and promote Skill Development by
providing free short-term courses and incentivizing this by providing monetary rewards to youth
for skill certification with total outlay of Rs.12000 Crores. Identify the correct statement/s with
respect to scheme Y

(1) 60% of the funding is being provided by the central government under centrally sponsored
centrally managed component of the scheme, while the rest 40% is provided by the respective
state government
(2) There are three components of the scheme viz; short term training, recognition of prior
learning and special projects
(3) The 4th edition of scheme Y was announced in union budget 2022-23
(4) The 3rd edition of scheme Y was focused on 717 districts with an aim to target 8 lakh candidates

[a] Only 1 and 2
[b] Only 2, 3 and 4


                                                                                                                        pg. 13

[Type here]



[c] Only 1, 3 and 4
[d] Only 2 and 4
[e] Only 1 and 3

Solution – [d]

Explanation – The Scheme Y is PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana. The 4th edition of the scheme was
announced in union budget 2023-24

Funding pattern
   •  Centrally sponsored centrally managed
       o  This component is implemented by NSDC.
       o 75% of the total funding will be provided by central government and 25% by the
             respective state government.

   •  Centrally sponsored state managed
       o   It is implemented by state governments through state skill development missions.
       o 25% of the total funding is provided by central government, rest is provided by
             respective state government.


Q.129) Project X is being implemented in six states of the country to augment skill training in tribal
communities for their inclusive and sustainable growth. It was launched by National Skill
Development Corporation (NSDC) in partnership with Seva Bharti and Yuva Vikas Society. It is
being implemented under Sansadiya Sankul Pariyojana. In which of the following states, the
project is being implemented?

(1) Maharashtra
(2) Bihar
(3) Jharkhand
(4) Uttar Pradesh
(5) Madhya Pradesh
(6) Rajasthan

[a] All 1,2,3,4,5 and 6
[b] Only 2,3 and 4
[c] Only 1,3,5 and 6
[d] Only 2,3 and 5
[e] Only 1,2,3,4 and 5

Solution – [c]

Explanation – The project X is Grameen Udyami Project. It is being implemented in 6 states viz;
         ▪  Maharashtra
                                                                                                                        pg. 14

[Type here]



         ▪  Rajasthan
         ▪  Chhattisgarh
         ▪  Madhya Pradesh
         ▪  Jharkhand
         ▪  Gujarat
      Ministry of Labour & Employment


Q.130) Mukesh works in a furniture shop as a carpenter. He has been working in this shop for 10
years. That day, during the lunch break, he and his colleagues were discussing their respective
retirement plan. Mukesh’s friend Sachin told everyone that he has enrolled himself under a
scheme being implemented by ministry of labour and employment, launched in 2019. The scheme
is a pension benefit schemes for unorganized workers. On attaining 60 years of age, Rs.3000 as
pension is provided to the beneficiary worker. Mukesh asked Sachin if he also can enrol under the
scheme. To that, Sachin denied by giving a reason. What could be the reason/s of Mukesh’s
ineligibility?

(1) He is 29 years old and earns Rs.14500 per month as salary
(2) He is a beneficiary of EPFO scheme
(3) He is already a beneficiary of Atal Pension Yojana

[a] Only 1
[b] Only 2 and 3
[c] Only 1 and 3
[d] Only 3
[e] Only 2

Solution – [e]

Explanation – The scheme mentioned in the passage is PM Shram Yogi Maan Dhan Yojana.
Following is the eligibility of the scheme –

Eligibility
      •  Age – Minimum – 18 years    Maximum – 40 years
      •  Income – Rs.15000 or less


Ineligible:
   •  A member of any other pension scheme like EPFO/ESIC/NPS or an income tax payer is not
        eligible.
   •  Exception – Atal Pension Yojana, If eligible





                                                                                                                        pg. 15

[Type here]



Q.131) Gaurav is a small trader in the Kalkaji area of New Delhi. He enrolled himself as a
beneficiary under PM Laghu Vyapari Maan Dhan Yojana when he was 29 years old. One day while
going to his shop he met with an unfortunate accident which led to the disablement of his both
legs. The accident happened when Gaurav was 32 years old. Now, since he is not able to
contribute to the PM Laghu Vyapari Maan Dhan Scheme, what will happen to his enrolment under
the scheme?

[a] Gaurav’s wife can continue the scheme by contributing half the amount which he was
contributing
[b] His wife can take an Exit the scheme by receiving only the share of contribution with interest as
actually earned by the Pension Fund
[c] His wife can take an Exit the scheme by receiving the share of contribution with interest as
actually earned by the Pension Fund or the interest at the savings bank interest rate thereon,
whichever is lower
[d] Gaurav’s wife can continue the scheme by contributing one-fourth the amount which he was
contributing
[e] His wife can take an Exit from the scheme by receiving the share of contribution with interest
as actually earned by the Pension Fund or the interest at the savings bank interest rate thereon,
whichever is higher

Solution – [e]

Explanation – Gaurav’s wife can take an exit from the scheme by receiving the share of
contribution with interest as actually earned by the Pension Fund or the interest at the savings
bank interest rate thereon, whichever is higher

Q.132) Scheme X was launched in ……………… to provide unemployment benefits to the workers
who are insured under the ESI scheme. The scheme provides benefits to those insured Person who
have been under insurable employment for a minimum period of …………. before his/her
unemployment. Ministry of labour and employment has enhanced the benefits and now a
payment relief of …………. of average wages payable up to maximum 90 days of unemployment. Fill
the gaps.

[a] 2018, 78 Days, 25%
[b] 2019, 1 year, 50%
[c] 2020, 2 years, 25%
[d] 2018, 2 years, 50%
[e] 2018, 90 Days, 25%

Solution – [d]

Explanation – Atal Bimit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana was launched in 2018 to provide unemployment
benefits to the workers who are insured under the ESI scheme. The scheme provides benefits to
those insured Person who have been under insurable employment for a minimum period of 2


                                                                                                                        pg. 16

[Type here]



Years before his/her unemployment. Ministry of labour and employment has enhanced the
benefits and now a payment relief of 50% of average wages payable up to maximum 90 days of
unemployment.

Q.133) Deen Dayal Upadhyay Shramev Jayate Karyakram was launched in 2014 to provide
conducive environment for industrial development and doing business with ease through
introduction of several labour reforms. The scheme has 5 sub-schemes/intiatives. Which of the
following is not one of the 5 sub-schemes/initiatives?

[a] Shram Suvidha Portal
[b] Random labour Inspection Scheme
[c] Universal Account number for Employee PF
[d] Apprenticeship Protsahan Yojana
[e] e-Shram Portal

Solution – [e]

Explanation – The five sub-schemes are –
   •  Shram Suvidha Portal
   •  Random labour Inspection Scheme
   •  Universal Account number for Employee PF
   •  Apprenticeship Protsahan Yojana
   •  Revamped Rashtriya Swasthya Yojana

Q.134) Which of the following statements is correct with respect to the scheme launched in 2020
to boost employment in formal sector and incentivize creation of new employment opportunities
during the COVID recovery phase under AatmaNirbhar Bharat Package 3.0?

[a] The scheme is being implemented by Employees State Insurance Corporation
[b] The last to register under the scheme was 31st December 2022
[c] For establishments employing up to 2000, Government of India has paid both 12% employees’
contribution and 12% employers’ contribution
[d] The beneficiary should have monthly income not more than Rs.12000
[e] For establishments employing up to 1000, Government of India has paid both 12% employees’
contribution and 12% employers’ contribution

Solution – [e]

Explanation – The scheme is Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rozgar Yojana. Option [e] is the correct
